user.title: Home Memory
user.description: Adds a topic-based memory that AI assistants can read and write through actions and the LLM API.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Memory is already set up.

invalid_topic.message: The topic name is empty or invalid.

content_too_long.message: Content is longer than {max} characters. Split it into several topics.

set.name: Set topic
set.description: Creates a topic or replaces its content. The previous version is kept for one undo.

topic.name: Topic
topic.description: Topic name, e.g. energy or pool.

content.name: Content
content.description: The knowledge for this topic (Markdown or YAML).

refs.name: References
refs.description: Entity, device or area IDs this topic is about.

title.name: Title
title.description: Display name. Defaults to the topic name.

append.name: Append to topic
append.description: Adds text at the end of a topic. Creates the topic if it does not exist.

delete.name: Delete topic
delete.description: Deletes a topic and its sensor.

restore.name: Undo last change
restore.description: Swaps the current and the previous content of a topic.
